test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit overlays Image Defeat [X] soft button on Rear View Camera Image when ShiftLeverPosition != R.

tcs.tc_title: X overlaid out of R, read the rear view camera image and check that the "X" exit button is overlaid on it
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. CAN source: TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts (637, 2261, 376)
4. The rear view camera image is displayed in Automatic Display Mode
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 4 (D)
2. Read the rear view camera image and check that the "X" exit button is overlaid on it
tcs.expected_result:
1. TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 4 (D) is sent
2. The "X" exit button is overlaid on the rear view camera image
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit overlays Image Defeat [X] soft button on Rear View Camera Image when ShiftLeverPosition != R.

(X overlaid out of R, read the rear view camera image and check that the "X" exit button is overlaid on it)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 SYS-RA-VF551_V2-533 之「ShiftLeverPosition != R 時疊加 Image Defeat [X] 軟鍵」。上半為摘句（§4.3.1）：原句 33 RE_TOKEN 含 a) 子句（R 檔不中斷），本列只取主句 17 RE_TOKEN，a) 子句由 NR1L-RVC-022 承接。前提須 Delay 為 On 之外的任一使影像於 D 檔續顯之情境，本列沿用自動模式退檔後之短暫續顯窗。V3-249／V4-115／V42-299 為三本同義列，依 R-CAM3(e) 不另拆，訊息名分寫於 CAN source 行。
